algorithm.analytic_rejection_rule: Skip only frozen geometry-bound, pairwise-center, and neutral-cone failures; never inspect model evidence.
algorithm.choice_rule: Interpret full SHA-256 digest as an unsigned big-endian integer and reduce modulo the ordered grid length.
algorithm.duplicate_rule: Skip exact duplicate original geometries in deterministic derivation-attempt order.
algorithm.name: sha256_domain_separated_quantized_geometry_v1
algorithm.p00_primary_rule: candidate rank 0 is the pinned historical neutral layout; P00 spares use the same hash generator as new layouts.
algorithm.reflection_rule: Exact per-object y negation; source quaternion bytes are unchanged.
